title: Real Python execution verified
summary: Python 3.14.6 now runs code and interactive input through the local lab using automatic interpreter discovery.

changes.detail: Removed the broken py.exe dependency from the interactive Python regression test as well as the code-run test.
Verified the Python discovery correction and started the local API and learning web app.

validation.name: Code runner
validation.detail: All 4 teacher-lab tests passed, including Python Unicode, standard library, traceback and timeout.

validation.name: Interactive terminal
validation.detail: 4 terminal tests passed, including Python variables, input and Ctrl+C; unrelated Kali test skipped. node-pty emitted AttachConsole cleanup diagnostics.

validation.name: Correction during verification
validation.detail: Initial terminal test failed because its setup directly invoked broken py.exe. Removed that test-only override and reran successfully.

validation.name: App TypeScript
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck passed. Used npm.cmd because PowerShell blocks npm.ps1.

validation.name: Local server
validation.detail: App change-history route returned HTTP 200; local lab API returned expected 405 for unsupported GET.

validation.name: Limits
validation.detail: No signed-in browser interaction, phone test or deployment. Focused ESLint has not completed. Python execution requires the local PC and lab server.
